verdict.rationale: Gram's docs describe a catalog for discovering and importing official third-party MCP servers, backed by the official MCP Registry. Admins can also find and add servers from inside an MCP client through the platform MCP. A dashboard harness lets you test servers before connecting a real client, which covers the core browse-and-evaluate-before-wiring story. Missing for 10: explicit search or filtering by capability, detail on catalog size and browse UX, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
